description: This file defines a 'starboard::ScopedFile' class providing RAII-style file descriptor management, along with utility functions for file operations such as delete, read, write, and validation, built on top of POSIX system calls.

classes.name: ScopedFile
classes.description: A RAII class that manages a file descriptor, opening it upon construction and closing it upon destruction, providing methods for file operations.

methods.name: ScopedFile
methods.description: Constructor that opens a file with specified flags and mode.

methods.name: ScopedFile
methods.description: Constructor that opens a file with specified flags and default permissions.

methods.name: ~ScopedFile
methods.description: Destructor that closes the file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the file.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all data from the file.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all data to the file.

methods.name: Truncate
methods.description: Truncates the file to a specified length.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.
